report.summary: The alert is firing because its condition is genuinely satisfied: at the alert time the trailing-5-minute ratio of ERROR checkout PlaceOrder SERVER spans to all such spans evaluated to 1 (13cae997-6655-4a28-8aeb-94a068b924d3-t0:62fa6b40-6c83-4e05-abe6-efb11ec42436), starting from 0 through 05:48:54Z and rising to 0.333 at ~05:49:54Z, 0.5 at ~05:50:54Z, then 1.0 from ~05:51:54Z to the end of the window (13cae997-6655-4a28-8aeb-94a068b924d3-t1:d339470c-715f-40e1-bee9-d59837289633). The visible failure is a card-charge rejection: sampled checkout PlaceOrder server spans record ERROR with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: ... rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, while the payment-side span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge throws 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' at charge.js:37 (13cae997-6655-4a28-8aeb-94a068b924d3-t3:df064bad-539b-4f4a-8447-18cb01041ff8). Payment Charge ERROR activity starts at ~05:49:54Z and climbs to 7.5 spans per 5 minutes (4c6841bb-dd6a-476a-8039-25cb841c679d-t1:1cd76fe7-32a5-42b8-9821-c362f8260c86), coinciding with the checkout ratio onset. The rest of checkout's sampled downstream calls (cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog) show grpc status 0 in the same traces, so the alert reflects a failure localized to the payment charge step being surfaced through PlaceOrder, not a general checkout outage, and the annotation's '100%' applies only to the trailing 5-minute window (the full-hour PlaceOrder error ratio is ~11%).
